producer_report.summary:
I wrote review 2 of the revised study design as docs/design/reviews/study-capability-m1-review-2.md, in review 1's format. The verdict is approve with changes: 0 blockers, 3 major, 6 minor, 3 nits. Under §9, no build should be scheduled until the three majors are answered. Of the 17 dispositions, 15 hold as written and M2 and M7 hold only in part. All 8 decisions are carried into the text. I added a CHANGELOG entry and did not edit the design, review 1 or decisions.md. `cargo test --locked` passed. The majors:
- **N1:** the decision that native streams are required for the claims that use them is only a sentence in §4. No §5.4 rule enforces it.
- **N2:** the §2.1 containment and provider-side spend limit are not shown to be feasible for the systems BRIEF:99 names. If they are not, "the run does not start" makes every study read-only.
- **N3:** guards have no stated grammar, so "Undeclared counter" is not mechanical. The §5.3 example's `slot < limit` guard uses names the model never declares.

checks_run.note: All suites passed, including the xtask policy tests (8 passed). The BRIEF.md line citations were checked by reading the file, not by a command.

open_issues: The deliverables list names docs/design/study-capability-m1.md and docs/decisions.md as modify. Criterion 7 and the out-of-scope list forbid editing the design, so I left both untouched.

The review's three user decisions are open: whether to run a system that has no spend-limited credential, whether two rules should stay waivable, and whether to confirm D64 as the author's delegated decisions.
The review notes that the "chosen for review" labels on A1-A to A4-A will go stale once the design is accepted.
mistakes: I wrote the nit count as 2 in the header at first and fixed it to 3 (v1–v3). No other mistakes noticed.
learnings: Appendix A has 17 finding rows, not the 15 the brief said (M1–M7, m1–m8, n1, n2); the CHANGELOG also says 17.
The §5.4 table has 18 rules: 8 evidence and 10 model. Review 1 counted 14.
The design mentions firstmate 6 times, all disclaimers or scope lines.
The Appendix A wording "six evidence rules plus quote, pin and card rules" reads as 9, but the table has 8, because the pin rule is Wrong SHA, already among the six.
v0 records are unsigned (§16.2), so a waiver's "cites a user intervention" can be checked only against the record's `source` field.
The sandbox has one commit, so the revision's own diff is not visible. The scope check (check 8) rests on searches and on §8.
